description: Defines the GstMappedBuffer class for managing GStreamer buffer mappings, including constructor, destructor, data access, size retrieval, and boolean conversion.

classes.name: GstMappedBuffer
classes.description: A class encapsulating GStreamer buffer mapping operations, providing access to buffer data, size, and mapping status.

methods.name: GstMappedBuffer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the buffer mapping with a given GstBuffer and mapping flags.

methods.name: ~GstMappedBuffer
methods.description: Destructor that unmaps the buffer if it is mapped.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the mapped buffer data.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the mapped buffer.

methods.name: operator bool
methods.description: Returns true if the buffer is currently mapped, false otherwise.
